WITH peak AS (
  SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.iso_id ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON b.iso_id = i.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code IN ('CAISO','ERCOT')
    AND CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
), peak_hours AS (
  SELECT iso_id, interval_start_utc
  FROM peak WHERE rn = 1
), shares AS (
  SELECT p.iso_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind','solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS renewable_mw,
         SUM(g.generation_mw) AS total_generation_mw
  FROM peak_hours p
  JOIN core.fact_generation_hourly g
    ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc = p.interval_start_utc
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  GROUP BY p.iso_id
)
SELECT 100.0 * (
  MAX(CASE WHEN i.iso_code = 'CAISO' THEN s.renewable_mw / NULLIF(s.total_generation_mw, 0) END)
  - MAX(CASE WHEN i.iso_code = 'ERCOT' THEN s.renewable_mw / NULLIF(s.total_generation_mw, 0) END)
) AS percentage_point_difference
FROM shares s JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = s.iso_id

WITH iso AS (
  SELECT iso_id, iso_code FROM core.dim_iso WHERE iso_code IN ('CAISO','ERCOT')
), peaks AS (
  SELECT b.iso_id, b.interval_start_utc, b.demand_mw,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.iso_id ORDER BY b.demand_mw DESC, b.interval_start_utc ASC) AS rn
  FROM core.fact_balance_hourly b
  JOIN iso i USING (iso_id)
  WHERE CAST(b.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
), generation_by_peak AS (
  SELECT p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc, p.demand_mw,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code IN ('wind','solar') THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS wind_solar_mw,
         SUM(g.generation_mw) AS net_generation_mw
  FROM peaks p
  JOIN core.fact_generation_5min g
    ON g.iso_id = p.iso_id AND g.interval_start_utc >= p.interval_start_utc
   AND g.interval_start_utc < p.interval_start_utc + INTERVAL '1 hour'
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  WHERE p.rn = 1
  GROUP BY p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc, p.demand_mw
), shares AS (
  SELECT i.iso_code,
         100.0 * wind_solar_mw / NULLIF(net_generation_mw, 0) AS share_pct
  FROM generation_by_peak g JOIN iso i USING (iso_id)
)
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code='CAISO' THEN share_pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN iso_code='ERCOT' THEN share_pct END) AS percentage_points
FROM shares

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN outage_type = 'planned' THEN unavailable_mw ELSE 0 END) / SUM(unavailable_mw) AS planned_percentage FROM core.miso_resource_outage_daily WHERE market_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-15' AND DATE '2026-10-21'

WITH da AS (
  SELECT AVG(d.lmp) AS avg_lmp
  FROM core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly d
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON d.location_id = l.location_id
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON d.iso_id = i.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
    AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
    AND d.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00'
    AND d.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
), rt AS (
  SELECT AVG(r.lmp) AS avg_lmp
  FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON r.location_id = l.location_id
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON r.iso_id = i.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
    AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
    AND r.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00'
    AND r.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
)
SELECT rt.avg_lmp - da.avg_lmp AS rt_minus_da_usd_per_mwh
FROM rt CROSS JOIN da

WITH da AS (
  SELECT AVG(d.lmp) AS avg_lmp
  FROM core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly d
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON d.location_id = l.location_id AND d.iso_id = l.iso_id
  WHERE d.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00'
    AND d.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
    AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
    AND l.location_type = 'hub'
), rt AS (
  SELECT AVG(r.lmp) AS avg_lmp
  FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON r.location_id = l.location_id AND r.iso_id = l.iso_id
  WHERE r.interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00'
    AND r.interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'
    AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
    AND l.location_type = 'hub'
)
SELECT rt.avg_lmp - da.avg_lmp AS rt_minus_da_usd_per_mwh

SELECT SUM(discharge_mw) / 12.0 AS discharged_energy_mwh
FROM core.spp_storage_dispatch_5min AS d

WHERE i.iso_code = 'SPP'

SELECT SUM(discharge_mw) * (5.0 / 60.0) AS discharge_mwh FROM core.spp_storage_dispatch_5min WHERE interval_start_local >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 00:00:00' AND interval_start_local < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 00:00:00'

WITH net_load AS (
  SELECT g.interval_start_utc,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code = 'wind' THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS wind_mw,
         SUM(CASE WHEN f.fuel_code = 'solar' THEN g.generation_mw ELSE 0 END) AS solar_mw
  FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = g.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
    AND CAST(g.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
  GROUP BY g.interval_start_utc
), selected_hour AS (
  SELECT interval_start_utc
  FROM net_load
  ORDER BY (wind_mw + solar_mw) ASC, interval_start_utc ASC
  LIMIT 1
), rt AS (
  SELECT r.interval_start_utc, AVG(r.lmp) AS rt_avg_lmp
  FROM core.caiso_lmp_rt_hub_5min r
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = r.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id = r.location_id AND l.iso_id = r.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
    AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
    AND CAST(r.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
  GROUP BY r.interval_start_utc
), da AS (
  SELECT d.interval_start_utc, d.lmp AS da_lmp
  FROM core.caiso_lmp_da_hub_hourly d
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = d.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_location l ON l.location_id = d.location_id AND l.iso_id = d.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
    AND l.location_code = 'CAISO_HUB'
    AND CAST(d.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
)
SELECT rt.rt_avg_lmp - da.da_lmp AS answer
FROM selected_hour s
JOIN rt ON rt.interval_start_utc = s.interval_start_utc
JOIN da ON da.interval_start_utc = s.interval_start_utc

WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT g.interval_start_utc,
         SUM(g.generation_mw) FILTER (WHERE f.fuel_code = 'wind') AS wind_mw,
         SUM(g.generation_mw) FILTER (WHERE f.fuel_code = 'solar') AS solar_mw
  FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g

  GROUP BY g.interval_start_utc

SELECT COUNT(*) AS hourly_rows,
       COUNT(wind_mw) AS hours_with_wind,

FROM hourly

WITH generation AS (
  SELECT g.interval_start_utc,
         MAX(g.interval_start_local) AS interval_start_local,
         SUM(g.generation_mw) FILTER (WHERE f.fuel_code = 'wind') AS wind_mw,
         SUM(g.generation_mw) FILTER (WHERE f.fuel_code = 'solar') AS solar_mw
  FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = g.iso_id
  JOIN core.dim_fuel f ON f.fuel_id = g.fuel_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
    AND CAST(g.interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
  GROUP BY g.interval_start_utc
), actual AS (
  SELECT interval_start_utc, SUM(generation_mw) AS demand_mw
  FROM core.fact_generation_hourly g
  JOIN core.dim_iso i ON i.iso_id = g.iso_id
  WHERE i.iso_code = 'CAISO'
    AND CAST(interval_start_local AS DATE) = DATE '2026-10-20'
  GROUP BY interval_start_utc

  FROM core.fact_generation_5min g

  WHERE g.iso_id IN (1, 2)

), aligned AS (

  GROUP BY p.iso_id, p.interval_start_utc
), shares AS (
